title: The Dog in Yellow Rain Boots
skyStory: Ninety-nine percent full and still brooding in Scorpio, the moon is in a mood for secrets and sly little reveals. It has been planning something all week, whispering to the wind and passing notes to the clouds. Tonight the punchline lands in two places at once. Mars spits out its tea. Saturn, for the first time in centuries, laughs out loud.

reading: At 2:22 this afternoon, give or take a minute, you'll see a dog wearing four tiny yellow rain boots, stepping around a puddle like a duke avoiding a moat. You'll stop. You'll stare. You'll send Nancy a photo, and her photo will arrive at the exact same moment: a different dog, a different town, the same tiny boots.

DES. There is no other response. The Scorpio moon is showing off, reminding you both that the threads between the cabin and the shore are tighter than anybody thinks. The rest of the day hums. Make one grand ruling about something small, like what to name the cabin's newest chair, and enjoy how easy it feels.
joel.mission: Name one object in your home today, officially, and tell someone its full name and title.
joel.omen: Any yellow thing at 2:22. The universe is winking at you, and it wants a wink back.
joel.stoneWhy: a sparkle for a shared joke

reading: The Scorpio moon has saved its best trick for you, and you'll get it in the middle of an ordinary errand. Keep your phone handy around 2:20. That's all the hint the moon is willing to give.

When it happens, when the dog in yellow rain boots trots past and Joel's matching photo lands in the same breath, don't even scream. Okay, scream a little. Then sit with it. Life Path 11 is about seeing connections other people miss, and today the connection is so loud even the gulls noticed. The [[Wheel of Fortune]] spins, and for once it's spinning just for fun.
nancy.mission: Take a photo of something yellow at exactly 2:22 pm and send it to Joel with no explanation.
nancy.omen: A gull laughing on a rooftop. It saw the boots too. Laugh back; joy is meant to be shared.
nancy.stoneWhy: the shore's stone for a shore day
nancy.elementWhy: puddles, boots and full moon tides

together.text: Tonight, write the official history of the Dog in Yellow Rain Boots. Joel writes the first sentence, Nancy writes the second, and you alternate until someone makes the other laugh out loud. File it under ΔΕΣ and never speak of it calmly again.

game.intro: DES: a dog in yellow rain boots. Saturn rules that today's photos must be equally ridiculous.
game.prompt: Something yellow. Zoom in until it looks like the surface of a mystery planet.
